name: Beef and Broccoli
subtitle: Velveted sirloin in oyster sauce, with lots of broccoli over rice
equipment: 12-inch skillet or wok with a lid, rice cooker

macros.portion: About 5 oz cooked beef, 2 cups broccoli and ¾ cup rice.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Protein depends on the sirloin weight.

before: Sirloin thawed in the fridge (allow 1–2 days). Slightly firm in the middle is ideal: it slices thinner.
notes: The baking soda is the Chinese restaurant trick (velveting): it raises the pH at the meat's surface so the beef stays tender instead of tightening up in a hot pan. Keep the marinade to a light coating; a wet marinade pools and the beef boils instead of searing. Sear in two batches in a very hot pan for the same reason.

steps.title: Rice on
steps.body: Rinse **1 cup rice** and start it in the rice cooker.

steps.title: Slice and velvet the beef
steps.body: Trim the fat cap off **1¾ lb sirloin**. Cut into strips about 2 inches wide, then slice each strip ¼-inch thick across the grain. In a bowl, toss with **1 Tbsp soy sauce + 1 Tbsp water + 1 tsp cornstarch + ½ tsp baking soda**. Let it sit while you do the rest (at least **15 min**).

steps.title: Sauce and aromatics
steps.body: In a measuring cup, whisk **½ cup oyster sauce + ¼ cup water + 1 Tbsp soy sauce + 1½ Tbsp brown sugar + 2 tsp cornstarch + 1½ tsp toasted sesame oil**. In a small bowl: **4 cloves garlic**, minced, and **1 Tbsp grated ginger**. Slice **2 scallions** if using.

steps.title: Staging check
steps.body: Within reach: broccoli, **⅓ cup water**, the lid, a large bowl for broccoli, the beef, a plate for seared beef, the aromatics, the sauce (whisk again right before using), oil and tongs.

steps.title: Steam the broccoli
steps.body: Skillet over high. Add **1½ lb broccoli** and **⅓ cup water**, cover, and steam **3 min** until bright green and just tender. Tip into the bowl and wipe the pan dry.

steps.title: Sear beef, batch 1
steps.body: Skillet over high until it smokes lightly. Add **1 Tbsp neutral oil**, then half the beef in one layer. Leave it **1 min**, then stir-fry 1–2 min until browned with a little pink left. Move to the plate.

steps.title: Sear beef, batch 2
steps.body: Add **1 Tbsp neutral oil** and repeat with the rest of the beef: **1 min** untouched, 1–2 min stirring. Move to the plate.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.body: Heat down to medium. Add **1 tsp neutral oil**, then the **garlic and ginger**, and stir 30 seconds. Whisk the sauce again, pour it in, and stir until it bubbles and turns glossy and thick, about 1 min.

steps.title: Toss and serve
steps.body: Return the beef with its juices and the broccoli. Toss 1 min until everything is coated. Serve over rice with scallions.

after: Pack 2 lunches: rice, beef and broccoli together.

source.label: Standard Chinese-American restaurant method: baking-soda velveting and an oyster-sauce glaze
